_comment: AOS Sprint 11 — Fractional Advisory Radar. Reuses Demand Intelligence's own five signal categories and organisation-profiles.json rather than re-scanning the same public signals (Microsoft Copilot deployment, ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, AI Governance Committee, Responsible AI initiatives, Chief AI Officer appointments) with a second, independent taxonomy — every one of those is already one of demand-signal-categories.json's own keywords. This engine's own new contribution is a different interpretive lens on the same real data: stage classification, fractional-advisory potential, and engagement-model recommendation.

stageByCategory._note: Emerging | Growing | Enterprise | Urgent — a distinct question from Buying Readiness Band (which asks 'how ready to buy', not 'what stage is this engagement'). failure_trigger always means Urgent regardless of anything else, matching demand_engine.py's own recommend_next_action() precedent (failure_trigger overrides band).

stageScaleUpgrade._note: An organisation matching only ai_adoption but at large scale (10,000+, same threshold demand_engine.py's own _organisation_size_score() uses) is upgraded from Emerging to Growing — scale is real signal too, not just category.

engagementModelByStage._note: Section — recommended engagement model, a four-value vocabulary. All four reachable: Urgent -> Implementation (there's already a real problem to fix); Enterprise -> Retainer (governance/regulatory maturity needs ongoing coverage); Growing -> Advisory (funded expansion needs periodic guidance, not full-time); Emerging -> Discovery workshop (too early for anything else).

potentialScoreByStage._note: Fractional Advisory Potential (0-100) base value per stage, before the buying-readiness adjustment below.

revenueEstimateByStage._note: Section — 'rank by expected consulting revenue.' Prefers a real opportunity-schema.json/pipeline.json figure (same 'prefer the real record' pattern established in Sprint 9/10); this is the honest, clearly-labelled fallback heuristic only, never presented as a real quote.
